verdict.rationale: v0 documents first-party project integrations that include "AI model providers," and its homepage claims automatic integrations with "no accounts required." That suggests a user could add AI features without handling provider accounts. However, no evidence says plainly that LLM calls or agents in the generated app run without the user supplying or managing API keys, and the env-var/secret storage docs point toward user-managed keys. missing for 10: explicit documentation that AI provider calls are keyless or platform-billed, documented support for building agents inside generated apps, any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can add AI features like LLM calls and agents to my generated app without managing provider keys myself

citations.quote: Available integrations include databases like Upstash for Redis and Neon for Serverless Postgres, backend services like Supabase, and AI model providers.
Build with your favorite tools and APIs. Automatic integration, no accounts required.
v0 is an AI agent that helps anyone create real code and full-stack apps and agents.
